data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Jesha’ meaning 'God' and ‘An’ meaning 'grace'. This name is believed to represent the divine blessings and protection bestowed upon an individual. Parents who choose Jeshan usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
